sentences.text: No, the documents do not state that RBI's penal charges instructions already applied to fresh loans on 2024-03-15; the effective date was changed to 2024-04-01.

The document in force says that, for existing loans, the switchover to the new penal charges regime is on the next review/renewal date falling on or after April 1, 2024, but not later than June 30, 2024.

missing.slot: whether the instructions applied to fresh loans on 2024-03-15
